description: Set the volume (in dB) on every audio clip of a track, or on a list of clip indices. One round trip instead of one call per clip - essential for sequences with dozens of clips.

clip_indices.description: Optional clip indices on that track. Omit to apply to all clips.

volume_db.description: Volume in dB applied to every selected clip (0 = unity, max +15)

name: set_clips_volume

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Set Clips Volume
